notes: CONFIGURE, phase 3 of 6 — a Rune's actual settings now open beside it. Select Date / Time and the 24-hour switch and the six live clock faces are right there; select Weather and its location and units are. Changing one changes the panel…

The controls are MOVED, not rebuilt. They are the same elements, already wired, borrowed into the pane and handed back when you select something else or leave the tab — so the old tabs stay whole and working while the rest of the move…
A Rune with no settings says so rather than showing an empty panel: Volume, Brightness, Microphone, Power Buttons, Bluetooth & Wi-Fi and Power Plan really are just on or off.

Fixed the clock-face gallery spreading over twice the height it needed, leaving a hole under every row. Two causes, isolated by substitution rather than reasoning: its rows were free to absorb slack, and the container handing them that…
